  • Class
    Description
    Assets
    Loads the Freedoom pictures from src/main/resources/freedoom/ and remembers them, so each file is read from disk only once.
    DoomFont
    Doom's small red message font (the "STCFN" pictures).
    EnemySprites
    Picks the right Freedoom picture for an enemy: which animation frame (walking, hurt, dying) and which of the 8 viewing angles.
    GameFrame
    The main application window.
    GamePanel
    Panel that renders the game into a low-resolution off-screen image and scales it to the window.
    HudRenderer
    Draws everything on top of the 3D view: the gun in the player's hands, the crosshair, screen flashes, the Doom status bar (ammo of the held weapon, health, Doomguy's face, armor), pickup messages and the pause / game over screens.
    MenuPanel
    The main menu: pick a difficulty and mouse sensitivity, then start or quit.
    MenuPanel.StartListener
    Called when the player presses Start.
    MinimapRenderer
    Draws a top-down minimap with the player's position and view cone, the remaining dots and power-ups, and the enemies (only while the player has the shotgun power-up).
    Patch
    One Doom picture ("patch" in Doom terms): a sprite frame, a status bar digit, a face...
    SpriteRenderer
    Draws flat pictures that always face the camera ("billboards"): enemies and pickups.
    ThreatIndicator
    The "sixth sense": when a dangerous enemy is close but the player cannot see it, the edge of the screen glows red on the side it will come from - left, right, bottom ("behind you"), or top ("around a corner ahead").
    WorldRenderer
    Draws the textured, fogged 3D walls plus the ceiling/floor gradient into an int[] pixel buffer.
